visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Inside a brightly lit indoor environment resembling a convenience store or cafe, a middle-aged man with short black hair wears a button-down shirt featuring a green and grey camouflage-style pattern. He looks upward with an expression of intense surprise, eyes widened and mouth slightly open, while a red square icon with a white character appears briefly near his head. (2) The man turns his body and walks toward a set of glass automatic doors, passing a stack of red plastic trays on a shelf to his right. He exits the building and enters a daylight-filled urban street environment, glancing around with a look of curiosity and focused attention. (3) The camera captures a wide shot of a multi-lane city road where a large group of people is marching on the sidewalk. Most individuals are wearing white safety helmets and carrying large red or blue banners with Japanese text; a blue SUV drives past in the foreground, partially obscuring the view. (4) Returning to the man, he stands on the sidewalk and talks directly into the camera while gesturing with his hands. Behind him, the continuous flow of the protest continues, with rows of participants walking in a disciplined line, many of whom appear to be elderly. (5) Several police officers dressed in dark blue tactical gear, black helmets, and high-visibility yellow vests march in formation alongside the protesters. The scene shows various urban elements like metal railings, green trees, and large commercial buildings in the background under clear but soft natural lighting.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A sharp, resonant digital "ding" sound effect opens the audio track, instantly followed by a middle-aged male voice speaking Mandarin. His tone is energetic and high-pitched, expressing surprise. A light, upbeat background music track featuring an acoustic guitar and a steady percussive rhythm begins at a moderate volume. (2) A shift in the acoustic atmosphere occurs as the speaker moves outdoors, introducing a dense background noise floor of city traffic, including the low-frequency hum of engines and tires on pavement. The speaker's voice remains dominant but is now accompanied by the distant, muffled sound of a crowd. (3) A series of loud, rhythmic vocal chants from a large group of people becomes the primary background layer. The chanting is organized and repetitive, with a clear cadence. The main speaker continues his narration, his voice maintaining a consistent volume and clear articulation despite the increasing noise from the crowd. (4) The sound of a sharp, high-pitched metallic whistle blows several times, cutting through the ambient noise. This is accompanied by the louder roar of a car passing close to the microphone, creating a temporary surge in volume and a shift in the spectral brightness of the background. (5) The chanting continues at a high intensity, occasionally punctuated by more whistle blows and the sounds of moving vehicles. The background music persists at a low level, providing a melodic contrast to the percussive nature of the chanting and the mechanical sounds of the urban environment.
